dogecoin.text:
There’s really nothing left.

The hangover of SNL could linger for a long time and possibly be looked back at as the single event trigger that called the top of meme coin mania. Time will tell.

If Elon on SNL couldn’t pump Dogecoin to a dollar maybe the joke stopped being funny.

Some takeaways from last night’s SNL:

- SNL highlights the non-use cases of Dogecoin.
- Elon admits that Dogecoin is “a hustle”.
- Elon’s mom single-handedly creates FUD by saying “please tell me it’s not Dogecoin.”

I didn’t watch the entire show. This is just what I caught.

Let’s do the math just for fun: Dogecoin has a current supply of 129.7 billion coins (which increases gradually like hyperinflated US dollar.)

For Doge to hit $50k a coin its marketcap would need to be about $6 quadrillion dollars...not enough money in the world. Not even close.
